why: updated, app check passed, and the snapshot restored in a drill
scenario: fresh compose stack (n8n, SQLite), 1 imported workflow, snapshot -> update -> healthz/version/workflow -> drill
note: One tested scenario per verdict (fresh throw-away test machine, the scenario field says what was tested), your setup may differ - read the release notes and keep backups.
reported_problems: Workflows whose trigger or Wait node has an ID longer than 36 characters (for example made through the API) may not publish and keep running the old version - not hit in our test (n8n #40606, closed 23 Oct; fixed in the stable releases n8n 2.46.4 and 2.46.5 - not tested by us. With npm, installing 2.46.0 to 2.46.5 fails (n8n #43006, open on 4 Nov); the Docker image 2.46.4 is out)

With a proxy set, the built-in AI Assistant can ignore NO_PROXY, so its calls to a model server inside your network can fail. A contributor says proxy support is still pending - not hit in our test (n8n #41342, open)
reported_problems_note: Problems other people reported for this release, read by us on the date given. They are NOT part of our test and not verified by us.
